buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Freshness points fairly clearly to Cobolli. Cobolli has 22 games on the legs over 14 days (1 match) against 113 for Alcaraz (5). In the past week Alcaraz has played 2 matches, Cobolli 1.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Alcaraz gets a slim nod on motivation and pressure. Alcaraz is on the way up (+11 Elo over 90 days) while Cobolli has been sliding (-69). Alcaraz's comeback rate is 60% against 33% for Cobolli, which matters if the first set slips away. Offsetting that, Cobolli is playing at home in Inalpi Arena, Turin, Italy, and the crowd should help with the big points.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Alcaraz holds a clear advantage on conditions. Alcaraz is the more proven player on Indoor Hard: 90% wins in 12 months against 55% for Cobolli. Alcaraz has 23 matches on Indoor Hard in the last 90 days, Cobolli only 12, so the adjustment period is shorter. Played indoors, so weather is not a factor.

bottom_line: The model leans Alcaraz at 91%; agreement across the three signals is 56/100 (mixed signals). The biggest risk is fitness & fatigue: Cobolli is fresher (22 vs 113 games in 14 days).
